definitions.explanation: A person who works in a store, helping customers and handling sales. Can refer to any retail employee.

examples.japanese: {店員|てんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{店員|てんいん}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{優|やさ}しかった→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The store clerk was very kind.

examples.japanese: {店員|てんいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いています→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a store clerk.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{店員|てんいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}せます→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: The clerks at that store can speak Japanese and English.

examples.japanese: {店員|てんいん}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{見|み}つかりました→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The store clerk helped me, so I quickly found what I wanted.

notes:
{店員|てんいん} refers to retail staff who serve customers directly. The word combines ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (store) and {員|いん} (member/personnel).

ADDRESSING:
When speaking to or about a clerk politely, add ⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧: {店員|てんいん}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧. This is standard in customer interactions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {店員|てんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask a store clerk
- {店員|てんいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call a clerk over
- {店員|てんいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a store clerk

RELATED OCCUPATIONS:
- ⟦{店長|てんちょう}→店長：noentry⟧: store manager
- ⟦{販売員|はんばいいん}→販売員：18939_hanbaiin⟧: sales staff
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧: employee (general)
- ⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧⟦{係|がかり}→係：02552_kakari⟧: cashier

NOTE:
{店員|てんいん} typically refers to retail workers. For restaurant staff, {店員|てんいん} works but ⟦ウェイター→ウェイター：05114_weitaa⟧/⟦ウェイトレス→ウェイトレス：05115_weitoresu⟧ or ⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧ are also common.
